description: This file defines a class 'Sale' within the OpenCart admin module, responsible for generating and listing product sales reports. It includes methods for initializing sale report tasks and retrieving sales data for products, interfacing with models like 'product', 'task', and 'sale/order'.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Controller class responsible for scheduling sale reporting tasks and calculating product sales data in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates scheduled tasks for sale reporting based on total products, dividing them into pages with a page size of 10.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves products based on given arguments and updates their sale data with total sales figures, returning a success message with the range of processed items.
